scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/db generate && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.start: bun run --cwd packages/db db:migrate && bun run --cwd packages/db db:seed && bun scripts/install-gold-modules.ts --bootstrap && bun run --cwd apps/web start
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/storage typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/pdf-pipeline typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/db typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.gold:modules: uv run --with pymupdf python scripts/prepare-gold-artwork.py && bun scripts/build-gold-modules.ts
